name: Al'ulA
description:
About This Game

[This game is a Vertical Slice created by a team of students over the span of about 7 months]

THINK ✨

Mariam, a Moroccan astronomer, is trapped in a realm of impossible geometry. Use your perception of space to navigate shifting staircases, twisting corridors, and non-euclidean structures where reality no longer follows the rules.

ROTATE 🌌

Use the Artifact to bend the world around you. Select rows of tiles and rotate them in any direction, reshaping the room itself. Twist corridors, align staircases, and rearrange the environment to reach new paths.

ESCAPE 👁️

A mysterious Entity brought Mariam into this fractal dimension. Solve puzzle after puzzle with the Artifact, uncover fragments of Mariam’s past, and discover the truth behind this impossible place as you search for a way out.
short_desc: Al’ulA is a first-person non-euclidean puzzle game set in a strange fractal dimension inspired by medieval Morocco. You will use an alien artefact to solve puzzles while guided by a strange alien entity.
